title: Nurses per 10,000 people by WHO region, 2023
description: Bar chart of the density of nursing personnel per 10,000 population in 2023 (latest data over 2018–2023): African Region 14.1, Eastern Mediterranean 15.5, South-East Asia 17.4, Western Pacific 44.0, Americas 72.2, European Region 76.9, and the world 37.1. Data: World Health Organization, State of the World's Nursing 2025, table 5.1.
heading: NURSES PER 10,000 PEOPLE, BY WHO REGION, 2023
